svg.title: HashMap resize split
svg.desc: Resize from 16 to 32 buckets. Old bucket 5 holds four nodes with hashes 5, 21, 37 and 53 (binary 000101, 010101, 100101, 110101): their low 4 bits are all 0101 = 5. The bit worth 16 (the old capacity) decides where each goes: hash & 16 = 0 for 5 and 37, so they stay at index 5 (the lo list, 5 then 37); hash & 16 = 16 for 21 and 53, so they move to index 21 = 5 + 16 (the hi list, 21 then 53). Notes: capacity doubles 16 to 32; no hash is recomputed, one bit decides; order inside each bucket is kept; tree buckets with 6 or fewer entries turn back into lists.
